say:0:1360014001:2.text: After dropping off the furs with Florabelle and delivering the decorative lanterns to Hugin, you finally return to Holistone.
say:0:1360014001:2.source_cn: 给芙拉贝尔带回毛皮，为呼金送去彩灯装饰……一番忙碌之后...

say:1:1360014002:0.text: By Dura's statue stands a radiant figure, captivatingly beautiful—
say:1:1360014002:0.source_cn: 而在女神像边，一个明亮的身影格外耀眼——

say:5:1360014003:0.text: Ah, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what a delightful surprise to cross paths with you here.
say:5:1360014003:0.male: Ah, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what a delightful surprise to cross paths with you here.
say:5:1360014003:0.female: Ah, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what a delightful surprise to cross paths with you here.

say:6:1360014004:0.text: Yes! We've been running around helping with the preparations for the festival. Miss Talene, what brings you to Holistone?
say:6:1360014004:0.source_cn: 嗯，我们跑了一圈，帮助各地的人过春焰庆……倒是塔琳小姐...

say:7:1360014005:0.text: I've come to celebrate the Emberlight Festival, of course. In a lively town like this, the festivities are all the meaningful.
say:7:1360014005:0.source_cn: 因为参加春焰庆，在这种人声鼎沸的城镇中才最有意义。

say:8:1360014006:1.text: Wait, Celestials celebrate festivals like this too?
say:8:1360014006:1.source_cn: 咦？半神也会过这种节日吗？

say:9:1360014007:1.text: Naturally. Allow me to share something with you—the Emberlight Festival is my favorite celebration.
say:9:1360014007:1.source_cn: 当然。而且不瞒各位，春焰庆是我最钟爱的节日。

say:10:1360014008:1.text: The flames of wisdom driving away the beasts of the night, the radiant dawn heralded with joyous songs...
say:10:1360014008:1.source_cn: 用智慧的火焰与闪光驱逐邪恶的巨兽，用欢歌迎接绚烂无比的...

say:11:1360014009:1.text: Fireworks that rival the brilliance of the sun, vibrant decorations filling every corner—it's a sight that stirs even the heart of a Celestial.
say:11:1360014009:1.source_cn: 可与太阳比肩的烟火，随处可见的鲜艳装饰……即便身为半神...

say:12:1360014010:1.text: I still recall soaring over towns aglow for more than ten days, their people celebrating without pause. Now that the festival is upon us once more, I couldn't resist returning to share in that mortal joy again.
say:12:1360014010:1.source_cn: 我还记得曾经飞过一座座连续十几天彻夜不眠，灯火通明的城...

choice_prompt:13:1360014010.text: I still recall soaring over towns aglow for more than ten days, their people celebrating without pause. Now that the festival is upon us once more, I couldn't resist returning to share in that mortal joy again.
choice_prompt:13:1360014010.source_cn: 我还记得曾经飞过一座座连续十几天彻夜不眠，灯火通明的城镇，如今又是春焰庆了，我也想再体验一下凡间的快乐。

say:14:1360014011:4.text: Ah, I know what Miss Talene means! She's talking about the two stages of the festival.
say:14:1360014011:4.source_cn: 啊，我知道塔琳小姐所说的，这是春焰庆的不同阶段！

say:15:1360014012:1.text: Precisely. Among mortals, the festival unfolds in two distinct phases.
say:15:1360014012:1.source_cn: 嗯，凡间的春焰庆似乎分为两个阶段。

say:16:1360014013:1.text: The first phase is all about preparation—facing the beast of the night and awaiting the dawn. This is called <style="highlight">March to Dawn</style>.
say:16:1360014013:1.source_cn: 先是进行筹备，对抗巨兽，等候黎明的阶段，被人们称为<s...

say:17:1360014014:1.text: Once the beast is vanquished, the second phase begins. People rejoice throughout the night, greeting dawn after dawn. This is known as <style="highlight">Brightening the Sky</style>.
say:17:1360014014:1.source_cn: 而等到战胜巨兽后，人们开始彻夜庆贺，直到迎接一个又一个...

say:18:1360014015:1.text: To symbolize the triumph of reclaiming daylight, the Brightening phase is marked by lighting lanterns, launching fireworks, and bustling markets.
say:18:1360014015:1.source_cn: 为了象征凡人重新夺回白昼，开阳阶段会彻夜点亮彩灯，燃放...

say:19:1360014016:1.text: Some towns revel for three to five days, while others extend the celebrations to twenty, their streets alive with joy. It's truly an unforgettable experience.
say:19:1360014016:1.source_cn: 短则三五天，长则二十天，大大小小的城镇都会举城欢庆……...

say:20:1360014017:1.text: Miss Talene, your passion for fire and light shines so brightly! You know so much about the Emberlight Festival! It seems you've been part of many of them.
say:20:1360014017:1.source_cn: 塔琳小姐不愧是喜欢火焰和光明的半神，对春焰庆了解得这么...

say:21:1360014018:1.text: In recent years, I've been preoccupied with fighting evil. But this year, thanks to Merlin, who not only rescued me from a Hypogean's trap but also aided countless others, I've been granted this rare reprieve.
say:21:1360014018:1.source_cn: 前些年一直忙于征战四处的魔物，但今年，梅林不止帮助了陷...
say:21:1360014018:1.male: In recent years, I've been preoccupied with fighting evil. But this year, thanks to Merlin, who not only rescued me from a Hypogean's trap but also aided countless others, I've been granted this rare reprieve.
say:21:1360014018:1.female: In recent years, I've been preoccupied with fighting evil. But this year, thanks to Merlin, who not only rescued me from a Hypogean's trap but also aided countless others, I've been granted this rare reprieve.

say:22:1360014019:1.text: Thanks to your efforts, I can once again witness the beauty of the mortal world. This year, I hope to stand with you at the festival's radiant grand finale as the twenty days of celebration come to a close.
say:22:1360014019:1.source_cn: 多亏你们四处奔走，我也能得闲一瞥凡间盛景。希望今年的春...

say:26:1360014020:1.text: Ahem. Sorry to interrupt your lively discussion, everyone.
say:26:1360014020:1.source_cn: 咳咳，在诸位激情的讨论中间打扰了，各位。

say:27:1360014021:1.text: You've been chatting so passionately—don't suppose you've noticed something's missing, have you?
say:27:1360014021:1.source_cn: 你们聊得太过尽兴，有没有发现身上少了点什么？

say:29:1360014023:1.text: I had a precious phoenix feather, carefully tucked inside a silk pouch, prepared for Merlin... but it's gone?
say:29:1360014023:1.source_cn: 我给梅林准备了珍贵的凤凰羽，装在丝绸袋子里……不见了？

say:31:1360014024:1.text: A pickpocket? Who would have the guts to target a Celestial?!
say:31:1360014024:1.source_cn: 是扒手吗？怎么会有扒手敢对半神下手？！

say:32:1360014025:1.text: From a hundred yards away, Archon Talene practically shines. Do you know what that means for the starving pickpockets of Holistone?
say:32:1360014025:1.source_cn: ……从一百码开外就能看到塔琳小姐身上散发的光辉，你们知...

say:33:1360014026:1.text: Money or magic! Either way, it's a jackpot!
say:33:1360014026:1.source_cn: ——钱，或者魔法！任何一种可能性都意味着数不清的财富！

say:34:1360014027:1.text: For those barely scraping by, any chance to grab some cash is fair game. Heck, even if a Hypogean was standing right there, they'd still take the shot.
say:34:1360014027:1.source_cn: 对于要填饱肚子的现实主义者来说，只要能搞到钱，哪怕在眼...

say:35:1360014028:1.text: And you were so caught up in your conversation you didn't even notice what was happening around you. Naturally, some poor soul thought they could get away with it.
say:35:1360014028:1.source_cn: 更何况，刚刚你们专注于闲聊，完全没注意到四周……总会有...

say:36:1360014029:0.text: I can't help but feel a bit of pity for those who must survive by such means.
say:36:1360014029:0.source_cn: ……对于那些不得不优先考虑生存的人，我觉得十分遗憾。

say:37:1360014030:1.text: Do not worry, Magister. I will craft a new gift for you, though it may take a little longer than expected.
say:37:1360014030:1.source_cn: 梅林，我要重新为你准备礼物。只是要多花一些时间。
say:37:1360014030:1.male: Do not worry, Magister. I will craft a new gift for you, though it may take a little longer than expected.
say:37:1360014030:1.female: Do not worry, Magister. I will craft a new gift for you, though it may take a little longer than expected.

choice_prompt:38:1360014030.text: Do not worry, Magister. I will craft a new gift for you, though it may take a little longer than expected.
choice_prompt:38:1360014030.source_cn: 梅林，我要重新为你准备礼物。只是要多花一些时间。
choice_prompt:38:1360014030.male: Do not worry, Magister. I will craft a new gift for you, though it may take a little longer than expected.
choice_prompt:38:1360014030.female: Do not worry, Magister. I will craft a new gift for you, though it may take a little longer than expected.

say:39:1360014031:0.text: Please don't talk like that, Archon. A Celestial's gift ending up in the wrong hands is no small matter.
say:39:1360014031:0.source_cn: 不，塔琳女士，半神的赠礼流落在外可不是小事。

say:40:1360014032:1.text: If the local underground networks catch wind of this, we'll be in for a world of trouble. People with... less noble intentions will start turning their attention to Holistone, and we can kiss the town's peace goodbye.
say:40:1360014032:1.source_cn: 要是被附近的黑市和暗线知道，不怀好意的目光投射到圣石镇...

say:41:1360014033:1.text: Don't worry, though. I'll round up a team and track it down. We'll have your precious gift back in no time. The Emberlight Festival will go off without a hitch!
say:41:1360014033:1.source_cn: 我去带队搜查，把你们珍贵的礼物拿回来——无论如何，我希...

say:42:1360014034:1.text: Oh, then I'll offer my help too!

choice:38:0:1.source_cn: 诶呀，我更想要原来那份……
